title: Wegleitung zur Steuererklärung 2025
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Main guide for the 2025 return of natural persons: what is new, deadlines, every income, deduction and wealth item, family taxation and the tax calculation.
notes: 49 pages, PDF created 16 Jan 2026, no printed date. Page 4 has the table of changes for 2025, page 10 deadlines and reminder fees, pages 44 to 45 Tarif A and B and a worked Steuerfuss example, page 46 the Feuerwehrpflicht-Ersatzabgabe. Also published as HTML at www.ag.ch/wegleitung.

title: Übersicht gesetzliche Abzüge bei der Einkommenssteuer für die Kantons- und Gemeindesteuern §§ 35 bis 42 StG
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: One table of every cantonal deduction (professional costs, insurance flat rate, pillar 3a, childcare, training, donations, child and social deductions) with separate columns for 2026 and 2025.
notes: 2 pages, dated 15 December 2025; listed on ag.ch as Stand 01.01.2026. Columns run from 2026 back to 2001. The printed title uses an en dash between the paragraph numbers, replaced here by 'bis'. PDF metadata title still reads Stand Dezember 2022.

title: Pauschalabzug für Versicherungsprämien und Sparkapitalzinsen für die Steuerperiode 2026; Anpassung an die Prämienentwicklung gemäss § 40 Abs. 2 StG; Berechnungsgrundlagen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: States the 2026 insurance and savings-interest flat-rate deduction for married and other taxpayers and how it is indexed to the mean health premium.
notes: 2 pages, Bericht dated 24 September 2025. Explains the rounding rule of § 40 Abs. 3 StG and that the married amount is always double the other amount.

title: Merkblatt Kinderbetreuungskosten
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Conditions and limits of the childcare (Drittbetreuung) deduction under § 40 Abs. 1 lit. n StG, including unmarried parents and alternating custody.
notes: 9 pages, handbook Bd. I Reg. 5.1, Stand 1 January 2026, quotes the cap in force since the 2025 revision. No year in the URL: check the Stand line after each refresh.

title: Merkblatt Aus-, Weiterbildungs- und Umschulungskosten
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: What counts as deductible professional training and retraining cost and the yearly cap under § 40 Abs. 1 lit. p StG.
notes: 16 pages, handbook Bd. I Reg. 5.6, Stand 1 January 2026. A footnote gives the cap valid since 1 January 2025 and the earlier cap.

title: Liste Zuwendungen (Spenden) an Institutionen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: List of tax-exempt institutions to which donations are deductible (§ 40a StG), needed to accept or reject a donation receipt.
notes: 33 pages, handbook Bd. I Reg. 5.5, Ausgabedatum 1 January 2026, Stand 31 December 2025, for tax period 2025. Liste A covers institutions based in Aargau.

title: Merkblatt Krankheits- und Unfallkosten sowie behinderungsbedingte Kosten
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Which medical, accident and disability costs are deductible and how the Selbstbehalt works (§ 40 Abs. 1 lit. i and ibis StG).
notes: 20 pages, handbook Bd. I Reg. 5.4, gültig ab 1 January 2021; still the version linked on the filing page as of 2026-10-13. Refers to ESTV Kreisschreiben 11/2005.

title: Tarif für die Einkommenssteuer 2025
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Cantonal income tax tariff (einfache 100%ige Einkommenssteuer) with the bracket table and full Tarif A and Tarif B amount tables.
notes: 70 pages, dated 6 January 2025. Explains Tarif A (singles) and Tarif B (rate of half the taxable income, for couples and single parents), rounding rules and an example. Listed on the Steuern berechnen page as gültig ab 2025; no separate 2026 tariff PDF is listed.

title: Tarif für die Vermögenssteuer 2025
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Cantonal wealth tax tariff (einfache 100%ige Vermögenssteuer) under § 55 StG as revised for 2025, with amount tables.
notes: 37 pages, dated 6 January 2025, cites § 55 StG Fassung gültig ab Steuerperiode 2025. Listed as gültig ab 2025 on the Steuern berechnen page.

title: Verordnung über die Anpassung des Steuergesetzes an die Teuerung (Progressionsverordnung 2025)
publisher: Regierungsrat des Kantons Aargau (Aargauische Gesetzessammlung, SAR 651.135)
why_needed: Sets the inflation-adjusted income tax brackets of § 43 StG used for 2025 and, in this version, for 2026; the only official 2026 source for the brackets found.
notes: 4 pages, Stand 1 January 2026 (amendment of 15 October 2025 repealed § 2 and § 3 Abs. 1 lit. a to c; § 1 brackets unchanged). The version for 2025 is https://gesetzessammlungen.ag.ch/api/de/versions/3699/pdf_file; it still lists child deductions and a wealth tariff that the StG revision in force on 1 January 2025 replaced. Law collection PDFs are generated on request, so the hash may change.

title: Verzeichnis der Gemeinde- und Kirchensteuerfüsse für das Jahr 2025
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Communal Steuerfuss and the reformed, Roman Catholic and Christian Catholic church Steuerfüsse for every commune for 2025, with the cantonal Steuerfuss in the header.
notes: 9 pages, revision dates printed as 1 January 2025, 15 May 2025 and 1 January 2026 (v6, PDF created 21 Jan 2026). Last page lists communes whose church parishes span several communes. The filename carries a version suffix that changes with each revision.

title: Verzeichnis der Gemeinde- und Kirchensteuerfüsse für das Jahr 2026
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Communal and church Steuerfüsse for every commune for 2026, with the 2026 cantonal Steuerfuss in the header.
notes: 9 pages, revision dates printed as 1 and 22 January, 17 and 25 March and 16 June 2026 (v5). The v-suffix in the filename changes with each revision: re-check the Steuern berechnen page if the URL stops working.

title: Steuerfüsse und Zinssätze Natürliche Personen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Breaks the cantonal Steuerfuss into ordentliche Kantonssteuer, Kantonssteuerzuschlag and Finanzausgleich for each year 2001 to 2026, plus interest rates.
notes: 1 page, PDF created 17 December 2025, rows 2001 to 2026. Also gives remuneration and late-payment interest rates for cantonal and federal tax. Footnote: the hospital tax was folded into the ordinary cantonal tax on 1 January 2021.

title: Steuern berechnen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Index of all income and wealth tariffs and of the communal and church Steuerfuss lists by year, and the entry point to the official tax calculator.
notes: Page published 16.06.26. As of 2026-10-13 the newest income and wealth tariffs are listed as gültig ab 2025 and the newest Steuerfuss list is 2026. Check here for 2027 files.

title: Steuergesetz (StG)
publisher: Grosser Rat des Kantons Aargau (Aargauische Gesetzessammlung, SAR 651.100)
why_needed: Cantonal tax law: deductions (§§ 35 to 42), income tariff and Tarif B (§ 43), capital payments (§ 45), wealth tariff (§ 55), source tax (§§ 112 to 141), filing duties (§ 180).
notes: 133 pages, Stand 1 January 2025 (decision of 3 December 2024); the law collection lists no later or future version as of 2026-10-13, so it also governs 2026. The PDF is generated on request (creation date 9 Oct 2026), so the hash may change. A revision for 2027 goes to a vote on 29 November 2026.

title: Verordnung zum Steuergesetz (StGV)
publisher: Regierungsrat des Kantons Aargau (Aargauische Gesetzessammlung, SAR 651.111)
why_needed: Implementing ordinance: employee professional costs follow the federal flat rates (§ 12), commuting rule (§ 13), weekly stay (§ 14), extension requests (§ 65).
notes: 29 pages, Stand 1 January 2026 (decision of 29 October 2025). The 2025 version (Stand 1 January 2025) is https://gesetzessammlungen.ag.ch/api/de/versions/3705/pdf_file; differences found are procedural (small Nachsteuer cases, solar power certificates).

title: Verordnung über elektronische Verfahren im Steuerbereich (VeVSt)
publisher: Regierungsrat des Kantons Aargau (Aargauische Gesetzessammlung, SAR 651.821)
why_needed: Legal basis of eTAX AARGAU: electronic release replaces the signature, deadline rules, the post-submission correction window, and the clause allowing third-party declaration software to transmit.
notes: 8 pages, Stand 29 October 2025. § 3 Abs. 1 lets the Kantonales Steueramt allow third-party providers to transmit electronically. § 7 gives 48 hours to change data after the first submission, while the eTAX pages say 24 hours. § 19 says eTAX opens 1 February 2026; the eTAX page says 26 January 2026.

title: Verordnung über die Quellensteuer (QStV-AG)
publisher: Regierungsrat des Kantons Aargau (Aargauische Gesetzessammlung, SAR 651.712)
why_needed: Cantonal source tax ordinance: tariff codes, NOV and recalculation rules (§§ 6, 9, 10, 14, 15); the monthly tariffs are its Anhang 2.
notes: 10 pages, Stand 1 January 2026 (decision of 17 December 2025). The 2025 version is version id 3710 in the same API.

title: Quellensteuer 2026 Monatstarif mit Kirchensteuer (Y)
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: 2026 monthly source tax tables with church tax: tariffs AY, BY, CY, HY, G and the German cross-border codes, plus tariff assignment rules.
notes: 46 pages, Anhang 2 zur QStV-AG, gültig ab 1 January 2026. Includes cantonal, communal and federal tax and the Feuerwehrsteuer. Filename suffix -1 is a revised edition (PDF modified 19 Jan 2026).

title: Quellensteuer 2026 Monatstarif ohne Kirchensteuer (N)
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: 2026 monthly source tax tables without church tax: tariffs AN, BN, CN, HN, G and the German cross-border codes.
notes: 46 pages, Anhang 2 zur QStV-AG, gültig ab 1 January 2026, PDF dated 3 December 2025.

title: Quellensteuer 2025 Monatstarif mit Kirchensteuer (Y)
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: 2025 monthly source tax tables with church tax, to check 2025 withholding when comparing with an NOV or a recalculation.
notes: 46 pages, Anhang 2 zur QStV-AG, gültig ab 1 January 2025, PDF dated 6 December 2024.

title: Quellensteuer 2025 Monatstarif ohne Kirchensteuer (N)
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: 2025 monthly source tax tables without church tax.
notes: 46 pages, Anhang 2 zur QStV-AG, gültig ab 1 January 2025, PDF dated 6 December 2024.

title: Quellensteuertarife
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: Index of the source tax tariffs 2019 to 2026, the yearly Berechnungsgrundlagen sheets and the capital-benefit tariff for non-residents.
notes: Page published 19.08.26. The URL path really is spelled 'qellensteuern-abwickeln'. Links the 2026 Berechnungsgrundlagen sheet (qust-berechnungsgrundlagen-tarife-2026.pdf) and the ESTV import files for payroll software.

title: Quellensteuerpflichtige Personen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: Rules for source-taxed employees: NOV and recalculation deadlines, the NOV 2026 timing note, cross-border commuters and Merkblätter.
notes: Page published 09.09.26. States that until 31 Dec 2026 only 'NOV 2026 unterjährig' can be filed and that 'NOV 2026 ganzjährig' opens on 1 January 2027 and must be filed electronically by 31 March 2027.

title: Nachträgliche ordentliche Veranlagung beantragen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer, Revisorat
why_needed: NOV conditions for residents and non-residents, the 31 March deadline, cost, procedure and legal basis; the paper NOV form was replaced by an eService on 1 January 2026.
notes: Page published 09.09.26. The request itself is a JavaScript form in the Smart Service Portal (prozesse/svc0000130) and cannot be saved as a document.

title: Antrag auf Neuberechnung der Quellensteuer
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Sektion Quellensteuer
why_needed: Form to request a source tax recalculation (wrong gross wage, rate-determining income or tariff code), due by 31 March of the following year.
notes: 1 page, version V 7/2024, has a 'Für das Steuerjahr' field. The service page (neuberechnung-quellensteuer-beantragen) says extra deductions go through NOV instead.

title: Steuererklärung einreichen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Filing hub for natural persons: channels (eTAX AARGAU or paper), deadlines, reminder fees, and links to every supplementary form and Merkblatt for 2025.
notes: Page published 18.09.26. Lists forms 101.05a, DA-1 25, RUS 25, 101.06 (XLSX), 101.08, 101.09, 101.10, 101.20, 114.05 and the Merkblätter with their Stand dates. The main form set is not downloadable here.

title: Ihre Steuererklärung mit eTAX AARGAU
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Official description of the online channel eTAX AARGAU: AGOV login plus Adressnummer and Zugangscode, start date, sharing with third parties, data location, languages.
notes: Page published 14.09.26. eTAX AARGAU replaces EasyTax from tax period 2025 and opened on 26 January 2026; it runs in the browser at etax.ag.ch and is German only.

title: eTAX AARGAU Natürliche Personen Hilfe & Anleitungen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: Step-by-step rules for submitting in eTAX AARGAU: online-only submission, the 24-hour change window, receipts upload, eSteuerauszug import, EasyTax .a24 import, export and import.
notes: Page published 28.07.26. Recommends Edge or Chrome on Windows 10 or 11. The receipt (Übermittlungsquittung) and a provisional tax calculation are downloadable after submission.

title: eTAX AARGAU Fachinformationen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: FAQ for preparers and communal offices: one definitive submission per access code, eTAX returns may not be printed and mailed, eSteuerauszug import, delegation rules.
notes: Page published 20.07.26. The page title uses an en dash between eTAX AARGAU and Fachinformationen; replaced by a space here.

title: eTAX AARGAU Natürliche Personen: Liste der notwendigen Belege bei Online-Übermittlung
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Applikationen
why_needed: Which receipts eTAX AARGAU requires for each section (salary certificate, pension certificates, inheritances and more) when filing online.
notes: 2 pages, dated 23 December 2025. Missing receipts can be sent on paper with the Steuererklärungsbogen (hybrid filing).

title: eSteuerauszug
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau (Departement Finanzen und Ressourcen)
why_needed: How eTAX AARGAU imports the eCH e-tax statement: which positions are read automatically and which must be typed, and how to handle deviations.
notes: No publication date shown. Imported: categories A, B, DA-1, RUS, precious metals, custody fees. Manual: overdraft interest, debts, mortgages. The URL is a dc= topic view of the 'Alles zu Steuern' page.

title: Bestellung Formulare Steuerperiode 2025 für natürliche Personen
publisher: Kantonales Steueramt Aargau, Dienste / Formularversand
why_needed: Only official list found of the paper form set and its codes (101.01 main form, 101.02, 101.04, 101.05, 101.06, 101.07), which are not published as PDFs.
notes: Order sheet for preparers and schools, not a tax form. Also says the 2025 Wegleitung exists only online and lists the 2025 tariffs and donation list as printed brochures.
